description: Find churches near a location from SoapBox's public church directory. Given latitude/longitude (and optional radius, denomination filter), returns nearby churches with name, denomination, city/state/country, website, distance in miles, and whether the church is on SoapBox (with its community id for deep-linking). Public directory data only — no personal contact info.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, in decimal degrees.

limit.description: Maximum number of churches to return. The ranking is over the closest-matching passages this search found, so fewer churches may come back than you ask for.

lng.description: Longitude of the search center, in decimal degrees.

name: find_churches
